preconditions.description: The lengths n and m of the two strings are positive integers between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The lengths of strings A and B match the provided integers n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in A) and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max((4 * lcs_len(C, D) - len(C) - len(D)) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1) for k in range(m) for l in range(k+1) if (C := A[i:j]) and (D := B[k:l])) if any((4 * lcs_len(A[i:j], B[k:l]) - len(A[i:j]) - len(B[k:l])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1) for k in range(m) for l in range(k+1)) else 0
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum similarity score S(C, D) = 4*LCS(C,D) - |C| - |D| over all non-empty substrings C of A and D of B. If the maximum possible score is negative, the output is 0 (representing the empty substring case where score is 0).
